claims.observation: Bialetti lists 155 mm height for the 3-cup Moka Express geometry
Bialetti lists a 72 mm boiler-base diameter

limitations: Official dimension source is a current 3-cup color SKU; finish differs but declared Moka Express geometry and size match the classic 3-cup family

claims.observation: Front view shows the eight-facet boiler, narrower threaded waist, collector shoulders, centered spout and lid peak
Valve sits high on one boiler facet below the threaded seam

limitations: Wide-angle perspective and countertop shadow; no orthographic authority

claims.observation: Collector is visibly taller than the boiler while the threaded waist is a distinct shallow band
Spout projects from the collector wall as a tapered open channel rather than a separate cylindrical nozzle

limitations: Three-quarter perspective; use for shape relationships, not direct tracing

claims.observation: Rear view establishes handle thickness, centerline, taper and the open clearance behind the collector
Metal hinge is centered above the handle attachment and the lid rotates independently of the collector

limitations: Handle partly occludes collector rear facets

claims.observation: Profile shows the swept handle opening, upper attachment block and free lower grip tip
Profile resolves the spout lip, underside and short forward projection
Full profile provides a measurable height and width relationship across collector, waist and boiler

limitations: Perspective image; normalized ratios are approximate

claims.observation: Open views show the eight-sided chamber, rounded floor transition, central delivery column and integrated spout channel
Plan view confirms the collector rim remains eight-sided while the spout extends one sector

limitations: Foreshortened overhead views; interior wear can be mistaken for geometry

claims.observation: Underside view shows a separately cast eight-sided lid with radial ribs, center fastener and hinge barrels

limitations: Close perspective exaggerates lid relative to collector

claims.observation: Exploded product image separates collector/lid, filter plate, gasket, funnel basket and boiler

limitations: Retailer gallery contains inconsistent text metadata, so it is used only for visible component separation

conflicts.description: Retailers report values from 155 to 180 mm and some list implausible width/depth values without defining orientation or whether packaging is included.
conflicts.resolution: Use Bialetti's 155 mm current 3-cup specification as the absolute height anchor. Reject 170-180 mm retailer values as non-authoritative; retain the listing only for normalized shape ratios.

conflicts.description: The same-object listing never turns the boiler over, so underside stamps and recess depth are unseen.
conflicts.resolution: Keep the underside low confidence and out of primary silhouette acceptance. Do not invent stamps or detailed recess geometry; acquire a direct underside source before final underside detailing if the asset proceeds.
